name: Sawasawa Enikki 2 ~Futago to Chomechome Hen~
original_name: さわさわ絵にっき２～双子と××編～
source:
Finally, it's the summer break I've been waiting for! My parents are headed out on a trip with my cousin and his wife, and I'll be left all alone to do whatever I want!!

...or at least, that's how it was -supposed- to go...

When those 2 showed up, I couldn't help but sigh in disappointment.

They forced me to take care of the unpredictable Mayu and the predictable, but still annoying as hell Miyu. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE038499.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
终于迎来了我期待已久的暑假！父母要和表亲夫妻一起出门旅行，而我将独自留在家里，想做什么都可以！！

…至少事情本来应该是这样的…

那两个人出现时，我只能失望地叹了口气。

他们硬是让我照顾难以预测的真由，以及虽然很好猜却依旧烦人得要命的美由。

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE038499.html]DLsite English[/url]]
